title: Digital Transformation Operationalized Maturity & Assessment Model
description: Digital-business maturity and assessment model. Positions digital transformation as the reimagining of the organization's business and operating model as a digital business: grounded in advanced digital technology adoption (AI, agentic AI, autonomous systems, composable cloud-native platforms, digital twins), expressed through novel operating models across all operating concerns, steered by customer- and ecosystem-centric digital strategy, and run as a deliberate working model between humans and software agents. Every criterion is MECE-placed, carries five evidence-anchored progression levels correlated to the org's canonical L-1..L-5 capability scale (L-0 Not Assessed), and is independently assessable.
